name: FormCraft Self-Hosted Form Builder
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted form builder with drag-and-drop editor, form submissions, response management and SQLite or PostgreSQL storage; no vendor-imposed software usage quota or expiry.
watch_out: Self-hosting requires Docker and your own compute/storage. Public forms require securing the deployment; optional email or third-party integrations may incur separate costs. This is not a free hosted form service.
